narrative.headline: Top 50 tape is decisively risk-on — 32 of 50 mega-caps land bullish or lean bullish, led by mega-cap tech and consumer staples on massive dark pool prints.
bullish_setups: INTC: highest composite (9.69), $27.5M near-money call premium + $329M dark pool + max block conviction
TSLA: flow 9.22 with $30M call premium and $807M dark pool — institutions loading size
AAPL: $37.9M call premium + $1.13B dark pool, the largest single-name accumulation on the board
META: flow 8.99 + $983M dark pool + max blocks — high-conviction long build
AMZN: $15.6M call premium + $670M dark pool, blocks maxed at 10.0
AVGO: $53.1M call premium (largest flow print) + $820M dark pool confirms semis leadership
GOOGL: flow 8.04 + $698M dark pool — mega-cap tech accumulation broad, not concentrated
KO / PG / WMT: defensive staples all scoring 8.5+ with $160M–$370M dark pool — barbell alongside tech
C / AXP: financials split — money-center and card names getting $282M and $386M dark pool bids
bearish_setups: PEP: worst composite (0.74) with flow 1.24 — staples divergence vs KO/PG
PM: flow 2.27, distribution despite max dark pool magnitude
CAT: flow 2.48 — industrials weakness confirmed by GEV (2.54)
XOM / CVX / WFC / BAC: energy majors and money-center banks (ex-C) seeing put-side flow, WFC flow 3.32, XOM 2.97
UNH: flow 4.83, healthcare mega-cap under distribution
HD: flow 4.43, consumer discretionary retail crack vs AMZN/WMT strength
narrative.rotation_signal: Accumulation is concentrated in mega-cap tech (AAPL, META, AMZN, GOOGL, AVGO, NFLX, CSCO), defensive staples (KO, PG, WMT), and select financials (C, AXP). Distribution is hitting energy (XOM, CVX), money-center banks (WFC, BAC), industrials (CAT, GEV), and specific staples/healthcare laggards (PEP, PM, UNH, HD) — classic tech-plus-defensives barbell rotation out of cyclicals and energy.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: Financials are bifurcated — C and AXP bullish while WFC and BAC bearish, worth flagging vs any monolithic 'financials' industry read. Staples also split (KO/PG/WMT bullish vs PEP/PM bearish), so an aggregate staples signal would mask the dispersion.
